name: ParFDA
description: A collection of benchmarks and statistics for evaluating and deploying statistical machine translation systems, aimed at fast and accurate MT evaluation and deployment.
reputation: A niche benchmark historically used for statistical MT evaluation and deployment; moderate recognition among MT researchers but overshadowed by neural-MT benchmarks.
notes: Focused on statistical MT systems (not modern neural-only benchmarks); may be outdated for current neural MT, and metric suite focuses on automatic MT scores (BLEU/etc.).
